Authenticated users can view relevant no.name: Authenticated users can view relevant notifications
Authenticated users can view relevant no.using:
(SELECT app.user_id()) IS NOT NULL
    AND is_active = true
    AND (starts_at IS NULL OR starts_at <= NOW())
    AND (ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > NOW())
    AND (visibility IN ('all', 'authenticated'))
    AND (
      organization_id IS NULL
      OR organization_id IN (SELECT get_user_org_ids())
    )
